description: Defects that must not ship. scripts/replay_mutations.py applies each one, runs its gates, and restores the file; every entry must turn at least one gate red. tests/test_mutation_registry.py keeps the anchors from going stale.

a content word joins the stop list, so answers stop being graded on it
